Node.title: Node
Node.description: A node in the exported tree (Epic > Issue > Task).

ref.description: The node's full slug-path identity (e.g. "epic/issue/task"), used to address it in the API. Its bare slug is the last segment; the ref is unique across the tree, a slug only among siblings.

status.description: The node's own stored status, present only when it has one. Absent means the status is rolled up from children (see effectiveStatus); a parent can be reverted to the rollup by setting an empty status.

effectiveStatus.description: The derived display status (own status, or the rollup from children). Use this to show and filter a node's status.

files.description: Attachment file names in the node's own directory, other than the tree's own files. Empty for a task, which owns no directory.

markers.description: Warnings from validating the body against the section convention (Summary, Details, and Definition of Done required, Comments optional, all as "## " headings in that order), derived at read time. Absent when the body raises nothing worth warning about.

Marker.title: Marker
Marker.description: One warning from validating a node body against the section convention.

severity.description: The marker's severity. Always "warn" today; the field exists so a future stricter rule does not need a shape change.

message.description: A concrete, lowercase, English description of the warning, e.g. "no Definition of Done section" or "Details appears before Summary".
